    Cheesy sweet potato cottage pie topping

Cheesy sweet potato cottage pie topping
Fresh Ideas Image
Fresh Ideas
Cheesy sweet potato cottage pie topping
Prep
Preparation time is 10minutes
10m
Cook
Cook time is 25minutes
25m
Serves
Serve is for 8 people
8
Difficulty
Difficulty level: 1 out of 4
6 Ingredients
Number of servings
8

    1.50kg gold sweet potatoes
    1.50kilograms gold sweet potatoes
    3/4 cup milk
    3/4 cup milk
    60g unsalted butter
    60grams unsalted butter
    3/4 cup grated pizza cheese
    3/4 cup grated pizza cheese
    1/2 cup finely grated parmesan
    1/2 cup finely grated parmesan
    2 tbs chopped continental parsley
    2tablespoons chopped continental parsley 

Nutrition per serving
energy icon
1290kJ / 308Cal

Quantities above are a guide only. *Percentage daily energy intake is based on an average adult diet of 8700 kJ.
Description

Elevate your cottage pie with an easy sweet potato mash lid smothered in melted cheese for a deeply satisfying winter dinner.
Method
Step 1 of 3
Peel potatoes, then cut into 4cm pieces. Place in a large saucepan. Cover with cold water. Bring to a boil and simmer for 20 minutes. Drain. Heat milk and butter in the same pan for 2-3 minutes. Return potato to pan.cMash. Stir in pizza cheese.cSeason with freshly ground black pepper.
Step 2 of 3
Spoon mash evenly over filling. Using the handle of a spoon, run it over mash to create parallel lines. Scatter with parmesan.
Step 3 of 3
Bake DIY cottage pie from step 5 for 45 minutes or until golden and heated through. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve.
